==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{ety|ru|:inh|orv:служи́ти<ety:inh<sla-pro:*služìti>>}}
{{inh+|ru|orv|служи́ти}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*služìti}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|служи́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-служить.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|служи́ть|impf|pf=послужи́ть}}

# to [[serve]] {{+obj|ru|dat<someone/something>}}
#* {{w|Russian Synodal Bible}}, Mark 1.31:
#*: {{quote|ru|Подойдя, Он поднял ее, взяв ее за руку; и горячка тотчас оставила ее, и она стала '''служить''' им.|}}
# to [[serve]], to [[act]], to [[work]] ''(as)'', to [[be]]
# to [[be]] ''(something)'', to serve ''(as)''
# to [[be]] [[use]]d ''(for)'', to [[serve]] ''(for)'', to [[do]] ''(for)''
# to [[be]] [[in]] [[use]], to [[do]] [[one]]'s [[duty]]
# {{lb|ru|Christianity}} to [[serve]], to [[officiate]]
# to [[sit up]] and [[beg]] {{q|of a dog}}
